sections.text:
This document outlines the condenser inspection which must be performed every 
 4000 hours of operation

Maintenance procedures aiming to guarantee the perfect efficiency of the 
 components involved in the condensing system should be strictly observed as a 
 matter of fact a decrease in efficiency of failure of any of these units will 
 adversely effect the condenser performance

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil darwish reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed at 1 March 2009, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata approved by eng. Gomaa Khater khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station

Number of condenser :2 
 Total length of pipse : 7.5m
Number of pipes in each condenser : 6800 pcs

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.
Be sure the pipeline is drained

Inspect gasket and replace with a 
 new gasket if necessary

Clean tube condenser by source 
 pressurized water jet

Inspect tube leakage by pressurized 
 the shell and blocked any tube leaks

Introduction
This document outlines the condenser inspection which must be performed every 
 4000 hours of operation
Maintenance procedures aiming to guarantee the perfect efficiency of the 
 components involved in the condensing system should be strictly observed as a 
 matter of fact a decrease in efficiency of failure of any of these units will 
 adversely effect the condenser performance
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil darwish reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed at 1 March 2009, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata approved by eng. Gomaa Khater khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station
The condenser technical
Number of condenser :2 
 Total length of pipse : 7.5m
Number of pipes in each condenser : 6800 pcs
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.

Disconnect | Open | Closed
Manual | Inlet river water valve |  |  | x
Manual | Outlet river water valve |  |  | x

Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Rupper ball
Source pressurized water jet
Main crane temporary wood
Standard bolt drivers set

Work to be 
carried out
Be sure the pipeline is drained
Open condenser bolt
Inspect gasket and replace with a 
 new gasket if necessary
Clean tube condenser by source 
 pressurized water jet
Inspect tube leakage by pressurized 
 the shell and blocked any tube leaks
Close condenser

sections_ar.text: يوضح هذا المستند فحص المكثف الذي يجب تنفيذه كل 4000 ساعة تشغيل
يجب الالتزام الصارم بإجراءات الصيانة الهادفة إلى ضمان الكفاءة الكاملة للمكونات الداخلة في نظام التكثيف، حيث إن انخفاض الكفاءة أو تعطل أي من هذه الوحدات سيؤثر سلبًا على أداء المكثف.
أعد المسودة الأولى م. محمد أحمد خليل درويش، وراجعها واختبرها م. صبحي طلبة أحمد في 1 مارس 2009، وقبلها م. عبد الفتاح محمد شحاتة، واعتمدها م. جمعة خاطر خضر: رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء كفر الدوار

عدد المكثفات: 2 
 الطول الكلي للمواسير: 7.5 م
عدد المواسير في كل مكثف: 6800 مواسير

items: يجب إصدار تصريح عمل ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة فئة السلامة المناسبة.
سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير حول منطقة العمل
ارتداء مهمات السلامة والصحة مثل خوذة السلامة والحذاء، ...إلخ.
فحص الجوان واستبداله بجوان جديد إذا لزم الأمر
تنظيف مواسير المكثف بمصدر ماء مضغوط
فحص تسرب المواسير بضغط الغلاف وسد أي مواسير مسربة
